title: Sizzling Yang and Kenyan Bowl
description: A flavorful bowl dish combining the spices of Yang and the savory flavors of Kenyan cuisine, all wrapped up in a vibrant and snappy twist.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the yang paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the cooked kenyan and cook for 2 minutes, until heated through.
Stir in the vibrant fresh herbs and snappy beans.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Spoon the mixture into the bowls and serve hot.
Garnish with additional vibrant herbs if desired.
